name: Changedetection.io
description: Website change detection and monitoring tool that alerts you when web pages are updated or modified.

env.label: Base URL
env.description: Base URL for the application when behind a reverse proxy (e.g. https://changes.example.com)

env.label: Playwright Driver URL
env.description: URL of a Playwright browser instance for JavaScript-rendered pages (e.g. ws://playwright-chrome:3000)

env.label: WebDriver URL
env.description: URL of a Selenium WebDriver instance for browser-based fetching (e.g. http://selenium:4444/wd/hub)

env.label: Hide Referer
env.description: Whether to hide the referer header when fetching pages
